items.statement: Total liabilities fell sharply from Rs. 50 crores to Rs. 12.20 crores, a reduction of close to 75%.
items.quote: Our total liabilities in this period fell sharply from Rs. 50 crores to 12.20 crores. So, reduction of close to 75%.

items.statement: Trade payables reduced from Rs. 30.21 crores to Rs. 3.77 crores.
items.quote: We reduced our trade payables from 30.21 crores to 3.77 crores.

items.statement: Debt reduced by 40% and debt-to-equity ratio stands at 0.12.
items.quote: We reduce our debt by 40%. Now the company has entered a FY 27 in a financially sound position. With, significantly lower leverage and a clean liability structure.

items.statement: Finance costs increased from 0.48 Cr in FY25 to 1.3 Cr in FY26 due to working capital debt raised to fund capacity expansion and higher raw material prices.
items.quote: finance costs have increased significantly from 0.48 Cr in FY25 to 1.3 Cr in FY26

items.statement: Debt-to-equity ratio targeted not to exceed 0.6x; peak debt level expected by year-end FY27 then decline.
items.quote: maximum I think it should not be more than 0.6. It won't cross 1:1 for sure, it's maximum it may reach to 0.6 something.

items.statement: Working capital debt raised last year to fund production scale-up from 1,200 to 3,500-4,000 tons and cover 30% inventory requiring manual processing.
items.quote: We have gone for the working capital from the bank which we raised actually last year. And that will be there going ahead this year as well.

items.statement: Management prefers debt over equity to fund capacity utilization; no equity raise planned at this stage.
items.quote: we're trying to fill those gap with the debt instrument as of now rather just going for the going to raise fund through equity at this stage

items.statement: Inventory nearly doubled to ~18 Cr due to 25-30% of output requiring manual peeling at labour homes, creating dead stock.
items.quote: inventory values have nearly doubled from the last year. Now it's around 18 Cr

items.statement: EBITDA margin target maintained at 12-15% for FY27 despite raw material cost pressure and marketing spend.
items.quote: EBITDA we are we are focusing 12 to 15% at this stage

items.statement: PAT margin expected around 5-7% in FY27 as focus remains on EBITDA over PAT due to B2C investment.
items.quote: roughly PAT will be will be somewhere around 5 to 7% that's what we may reach we will be there

items.statement: Capacity utilization target 3,500-4,000 tons in FY27 and 4,500-5,000 tons in FY28 from current 2,500-3,000 tons.
items.quote: this year we are targeting 3500 to 4000 tons something and next year it will be somewhere around 4500 to 5000 tons

items.statement: B2C/D2C revenue currently ~50-60 lakh; targeting 10% of total revenue in FY27 including gifting.
items.quote: roughly it's around 50-60 lakh rupees in terms of value for that. But we are t argeting as a first threshold what we are targeting is somewhere around 10% of our revenue

items.statement: Revenue growth of 85% YoY in FY26 driven purely by volume expansion from capacity utilization increase.
items.quote: it's with the production expansion actually what we have done because we have utilized this capacity this year 2500 to 3000 tons. This is actually more than double what we have utilized last year

items.statement: Raw material sourced mainly from West and East Africa; local Indian crop costlier, so imports continue despite government cultivation initiatives.
items.quote: right now most of the material is coming from Africa only. Because the cost wise what we are processing right now if you look at the other market right now even including the local crop then also the costing is getting a little bit on a higher side

items.statement: Cashew shell (~70% of raw input) and husk (~2.5%) sold as by-products; ratio fixed regardless of production scale.
items.quote: approximately 70% is cashew shell what we get out of it. So we are selling it to the CNSL processor directly
